sloka: स ददर्श ततो रामः शक्त्या भिन्नं महाहवे ।लक्ष्मणं रुधिरादिग्धं सपन्नगमिवाचलम् ।। ६.१०१.४० ।।
transliteration: sa dadarśa tato rāmaḥ śaktyā bhinnaṁ mahāhave ।lakṣmaṇaṁ rudhirādigdhaṁ sapannagamivācalam ।। 6.101.40 ।।

translations.english: Rama beheld Lakshmana pierced with javelin in the great war bathed in blood and resembling a mountain with a snake penetrated into it.
